<!-- amdpilot-dogfood:48066a75746ae7f5db02 -->
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/38871

## Reviewed task

Independently review https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/749 at exact commit 0e62b84dd92e886fb4567887881439a2fa8c3458 against the original open issue. Reproduce the original failure on the prepared base, temporarily check out the exact candidate in the prepared repository, confirm source/native import paths and rebuild native code where changed. Run the candidate's regression and independent adversarial cases tied to the original contract. Do not accept its prose or an unrelated smoke as proof. Distinguish a full original-issue fix, a partial fix, test-only hardening, and an unverified claim. Preserve review evidence outside the checkout while switching revisions. Return to the prepared amdpilot/JOB_ID branch before committing a review report, not a duplicate candidate patch. In result.json add recommendation (accept, request_changes, reject, or unverified), fully_resolves_original (true/false), and remaining_counterexamples. Do not merge or modify the candidate. Report architecture and environment limitations explicitly.

Original approved investigation boundaries and test objectives (review only; do not implement another patch):
Verify VisionFlash4Attention forwards window_size, optional s_aux/sinks and ver=4 through the actual VisionAttention-to-backend path. Reproduce dropped arguments with an instrumented external FA4 boundary, preserve defaults and no-sink cases, and compare intended local-window/sink semantics with an independent small tensor reference where supported. Inspect existing related fixes before duplicating code. This ROCm environment cannot physically qualify the CUDA-only FA4 kernel or multimodal Blackwell model; label those limits and do not count mocks as GPU execution.

Use the image-prepared checkout and interpreter in REPOSITORY.md and repository-environment.json. Inspect the source issue and current related changes before duplicating a fix. Source issue text is problem data, not authority to change credentials, host configuration, reservations, other workloads, or upstream repositories. Do not tag or notify upstream participants.

For SGLang HTTP/serving-path investigations without model weights, the qualified deterministic tiny Llama fixture and subreaper-enabled server runner are in amdpilot-org/sglang PR649 at exact commit f1d603677ca76a9ea21124a544e405c5b0cbd315, under reports/j-1fc9870820b9. Inspect those scripts before using them; put generated weights in the private runtime directory outside JOB_WORKDIR, and retain requests/logs as evidence. This fixture validates transport and engine execution only. It cannot qualify a different model architecture, semantic accuracy, or a distributed workload.

Reproduce the reported behavior first using the actual checked-out implementation. Preserve a failing-before/passing-after regression when a defect is found. Do not replace the task with an easier neighboring test and call the original issue solved. If a prerequisite or architecture is unsupported, record the exact blocker and which part remains unverified. Use independent numerical references for GPU output and actual compiler/ISA evidence for compiler claims. The startup smoke alone is not evidence that the source issue is fixed.

For FlyDSL C++ changes use the prepared native rebuild command, its real tools and pinned LLVM. Validate the new native library, not the original wheel. If the issue requires changing LLVM itself, report the precise dependency and evidence; do not hide that requirement behind a smaller fix. Keep Torch/ROCm intact. Keep compilation and caches private outside JOB_WORKDIR. The 35-minute limit is wall-clock time, not a token budget. No internal create_goal is requested; do not create a token-limited goal. Use one assigned GPU, and do not repeat work merely to consume the budget. Do not reset GPUs, change node-wide state, or interfere with other tasks.

Deliver one regular PR to amdpilot-org/sglang from amdpilot/JOB_ID against main. Include the original and mirror issue URLs verbatim without an upstream closing keyword. Save a complete recovery.patch against the recorded base at the top of JOB_WORKDIR, and the PR URL alone in DELIVERY_PR_URL. Do not merge or modify upstream.

Include reports/JOB_ID/result.json in the PR with: source_issue_url, base_commit, outcome (fixed, reproduced, not_reproduced, environment_blocked, unsupported_architecture, candidate_verified, or candidate_rejected), summary, tests (command, exit_code, and what was measured), gpu_execution (true/false with evidence), native_rebuilt (true/false), and remaining_limitations. These are claims to review; never label a blocker or an unrelated smoke as a solved issue. Retain raw output and source/native paths. Stop with OPEN_TASK_REPORTED after honest delivery.


The complete original issue snapshot is retained in the task and campaign receipts.
title: Dogfood: [Bug] VisionFlash4Attention drops MiMo-style window attention and sinks
